'''Kench''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he engaged in [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
